title: PUROLATOR PRODUCTS, INC.: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS (10,000 affected)
summary: THE FUEL FILTERS WERE PRODUCED WITH AN INCORRECT THREADED FITTING. THE INCORRECT FITTING IS SIMILIAR ENOUGH IN SIZE THAT THE FUEL FILTER MAY APPEAR TO BE CORRECTLY THREADED ONTO THE FUEL LINE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (600 affected)
summary: THE 15 INCH WHEELS HAVE MALFORMED LUG NUT SEAT CONFIGURATION WHICH CAUSES POOR NUT-TO-WHEEL CONTACT AND CENTERING OF THE WHEEL DURING INSTALLATION.

title: Shyft Group: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (1,431 affected)
summary: PROPER OPERATION OF THE THROTTLE LINKAGE CAN BE RESTRICTED BY INTERFERENCE WITH THE AIR COMPRESSOR BREATHER TUBE.

title: COBRA INDUSTRIES, INC.: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:AIR SUSPENSION SYSTEM (459 affected)
summary: THE LOWER BRACKET OF THE REAR SUSPENSION AIRBAG MAY BE MISLOCATED, AND MAY BE RUBBING AGAINST THE BRAKE LINE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS (1,235 affected)
summary: THE FUEL FILLER HOSE OR FUEL FILLER VENT HOSE WAS DAMAGED BY A DRILL BIT USED TO INSTALL THE DSO PACKAGE ATTACHING HARDWARE ONTO THE FLOOR PAN.

title: Strick Trailers, LLC: STRUCTURE:BOGIE OR SLIDING TANDEM (461 affected)
summary: THE ATTACHMENT MECHANISM CONNECTING THE REAR WHEEL ASSEMBLY TO THE FRAME MAY FAIL.

title: MIDAS INTERNATIONAL CORP.: EXHAUST SYSTEM:PIPE:EXHAUST (1,102 affected)
summary: THE FLANGE OF THE EXHAUST PIPE HEAT SHIELD, LOCATED AT THE OUTLET END OF THE EXHAUST PIPE, CAN CONTACT THE VEHICLE OIL PAN. THE FLANGE CAN WEAR THROUGH THE OIL PAN CAUSING AN OIL LEAK.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD (4,300 affected)
summary: AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT ELECTRICAL WIRING HARNESS MAY HAVE BEEN ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO A SHEET METAL EDGE. THE WIRING CAN BECOME DAMAGED DURING NORMAL VEHICLE OPERATION DUE TO CHAFING, RESULTING IN AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN (33 affected)
summary: INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE PITMAN ARM AND THE STEERING GEAR HOUSING DUE TO INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER (56 affected)
summary: AS THE BRAKE PADS WEAR, THE BRAKE CALIPER TRAVEL MAY BE LIMITED BY INTERFERENCE WITH THE MAIN SUPPORT MEMBER (Z-BAR SPRING) OF THE SUSPENSION.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (409 affected)
summary: THE OUTBOARD REAR SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLY WILL NOT RELEASE THE WEBBING FROM THE RETRACTED POSITION. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (1,610,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: TAURUS AND SABLES BUILT FROM 10-14-85 THROUGH 8-19-88, AND LINCOLN CONTINENTALS BUILT FROM 11-4-87 THROUGH 9-30-88 (EXCEPT  1989 - 1991 2.5L TAURUS AND 1989 - 1992 SHO). THE AFFECTED CARS WERE ORIGINALLY SOLD OR CURRENTLY REGISTERED IN THE FOLLOWING STATES: CONNECTICUT, ILLINOIS, INDIANA, MAINE, MASSACHUSETTS, MICHIGAN, NEW HAMPSHIRE, NEW JERSEY, NEW YORK, OHIO, PENNSYLVANIA, RHODE ISLAND, VERMONT, AND WISCONSIN.  THE BODY MOUNTS AT THE REAR CORNERS OF THE SUBFRAME, WHICH SUPPORTS THE ENGINE AND TRANSMISSION, MAY BECOME DETACHED DUE TO CORROSION OF THE SUBFRAME MOUNT RETAINING PLATE. THIS WOULD ALLOW THE REAR CORNERS OF THE SUBFRAME TO DROP.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER (480 affected)
summary: DRIVER'S SIDE AIRBAGS DO NOT MEET CERTAIN REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 208.

title: Newmar Corporation: WHEELS (211 affected)
summary: THE WHEEL CAN DEVELOP CRACKS ABOUT THE WHEEL RIM SECTION.
